title: ELF: Embedded Language Flows
abstract: arXiv:2605.10938v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion and flow-based models have become the de facto approaches for generating continuous data, e.g., in domains such as images and videos. Their success has attracted growing interest in applying them to language modeling. Unlike their image-domain counterparts, today's leading diffusion language models (DLMs) primarily operate over discrete tokens. In this paper, we show that continuous DLMs can be made effective with minimal adaptation to the discrete domain. We propose Embedded Language Flows (ELF), a class of diffusion models in continuous embedding space based on continuous-time Flow Matching. Unlike existing DLMs, ELF predominantly stays within the continuous embedding space until the final time step, where it maps to discrete tokens using a shared-weight network. This formulation makes it straightforward to adapt established techniques from image-domain diffusion models, e.g., classifier-free guidance (CFG). Experim

translated_abstract: 扩散模型和基于流的模型已成为生成连续数据（如图像和视频领域）的事实标准方法。它们的成功激发了人们将其应用于语言建模的日益浓厚的兴趣。与图像领域的对应模型不同，当今主流的扩散语言模型（DLM）主要在离散词元上运行。在本文中，我们证明了连续扩散语言模型只需对离散域进行极少适配即可变得有效。我们提出了嵌入式语言流，这是一类在连续嵌入空间中基于连续时间流匹配的扩散模型。与现有的扩散语言模型不同，ELF 在绝大部分生成过程中保持在连续嵌入空间中，直到最后一个时间步才通过一个共享权重网络映射到离散词元。这种设计使得图像领域扩散模型中成熟的技术（例如无分类器引导 CFG）能够直接移植到语言建模中。
tldr: 提出在连续嵌入空间中基于流匹配的扩散语言模型 ELF，其直到最终时间步才映射到离散词元，从而让图像扩散领域的成熟技术（如 CFG）可直接应用于语言建模。
en_tdlr: ELF is a continuous embedding-space diffusion language model based on continuous-time Flow Matching that stays in continuous space until the final time step, enabling direct adaptation of established image diffusion techniques such as classifier-free guidance (CFG) to language modeling.
